newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin price recovers four cents to 13.81 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin price recovers four cents to 13.81 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended four cents higher at 13.81 ringgit ($5.48) a kg on a technical bounce after a sharp fall on Wednesday.
"Today, there was some good buying as the market fell sharply yesterday," said a trader. He added that the slight overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME) also did not affect sentiment much.
Traders said the local price would have risen to 14 ringgit this week if copper had been stronger on the LME.
There were bids for 92 tonnes on the local market, against offers for 71. Turnover totalled 70 tonnes against 90 on Wednesday. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.
The local premium against London widened to $70 a tonne from $40 previously.
